title: Two years old, and a new toy
body: Dohyun can walk quite well now. With a new toy in hand, what does the child do first? What you pick leans the child's temperament that way; moments like these add up, and it settles by about age five.

title: A flood has struck
body: Your home and your community were badly damaged.

t: In January undefined, you were born a boy in rural northern areas, North Korea, into a middle-income family. You are the firstborn. Your family has no particular religion.
You got your basic vaccinations (DTP and measles).
You took your first steps. The whole family clapped.
You said your first word: ‘Mama’.
You spent Lunar New Year with your family.
You did not let go of the toy until you had worked out how it moved.
Your maternal grandmother told you stories from long ago.
For the holidays the whole family gathered at your paternal grandmother's home.
You played in the mud and got your clothes filthy.
There was no electricity, so after sunset you lived by lamplight.
A younger sister was born.
At home, meals were cooked over a smoky fire. When smoke filled the kitchen, your eyes stung and you coughed.
You played with the neighborhood kids until the sun went down.
You and Jiyu became best friends.
All day long, you tended the animals and helped in the fields.
You sat beside your paternal grandmother looking at old photographs for a long time.
You started primary school.
The owner, an old woman, thanked you again and again.
You finished the school year with average grades.
A younger sister was born.
You learned to ride a bicycle on the village road. After a few falls you rode off on your own.
You fell in love with football.
With a ball made of rolled-up plastic bags, you played football barefoot until the sun went down.
A good teacher got you interested in writing.
You spent Lunar New Year with your family.
Your paternal grandmother slipped you some pocket money on the quiet. (+$5)
Looking after your younger sisters left you no time to play.
On the day of the first heavy snow you had a snowball fight with the neighbourhood children and built a snowman.
There was no electricity, so after sunset you lived by lamplight.
You fell from the big tree at the edge of the village and scraped your knees. The next day you climbed it again.
You finished the school year with good grades.
You finished primary school.
You walked the neighborhood until the neighbors' runaway puppy was found.
You went on to middle school.
Looking after your younger sisters left you no time to play.
You and Jinwoo became best friends.
You had a crush on a classmate.
Your voice began to crack and deepen. You shot up in a year, and your trousers were soon too short.
You and Suyeon became best friends.
Your parents slipped the teacher an envelope, and after that the teacher looked at you differently. Somehow it didn't sit easy with you.
Your parents said not yet.
You finished the school year with average grades.
You finished middle school.
Your maternal grandmother sent you home with a big batch of home-cooked food.
You were mobilized to plant rice.
You went on to high school.
You made friends who shared your love of football.
There was no electricity, so after sunset you lived by lamplight.
A good teacher got you interested in science.
You got through an important exam without trouble.
You graduated from high school.
You had a crush on a friend from the neighborhood.
You spent Lunar New Year with your family.
You went to help a disaster-hit area rebuild.
